deathwall.name: Deathwall
deathwall.should_have_been: Nobody touches the edge of the arena. Walking into the deathwall kills with no damage packet, and it is always a mistake. Before any other death, Damage Down, or Hysteria in the pull it is that player's own mistake. After one, it is still a mistake, but the first mistake of the pull usually caused it.

mechanics.name: Eternal Conviction
mechanics.should_have_been: Tanks take about 64k and usually live. Healers and DPS take about 97k of the same cast. The stack size does not change the hit.

moments.should_have_been: Everyone is inside a tower. An empty tower explodes for the raid. Tanks take about 58–66k of that explosion. Everyone else takes about 90–105k. The players who missed the tower own it.

mechanics.name: Sacred Sever
mechanics.should_have_been: Four players share each jump. The single sword is first, then the double sword, then those two jumps again. A lived share of 4 is tanks about 24–48k, healers about 43–67k, and DPS about 40–64k. A share of 1 or 2 under the role cap is missing bodies. A cleave is not the share.

mechanics.name: Hiemal Storm
mechanics.should_have_been: Pairs share the placed ice. Tanks take about 14–25k. Healers take about 23–38k. DPS take about 26–40k. It does not split further. A puddle that covers a tower is a wrong drop.

mechanics.name: Holy Impact
mechanics.should_have_been: The two prey players drop the comets apart. Too close explodes and puts Damage Down on the party. Those two own it. Tanks take about 57–66k of the explosion. Everyone else takes about 91–106k.

mechanics.name: Dragon's Rage
mechanics.should_have_been: The three non-tanks without the blue marker stack under Thordan. A lived share is about 60–80k, usually 5 people, those three plus both tanks. Whether the tanks are supposed to share it is not known, so 5 stays the full share. A stack of 3 around 102–113k is that share with two bodies missing.

mechanics.name: Skyward Leap
mechanics.should_have_been: The blue marker on three non-tanks. Opposite Thordan is as far away as possible. East and west are slightly toward the north, not too far. A real leap is 59–70k. Dying to it is a healer mistake when they were not full, and a mitigation mistake when they were full and the mit was missing. A clip is someone out of that spot.

moments.should_have_been: Six towers follow the blue markers. The three on those markers are fixed. The other three are not fixed, so two people in one of them is a miscommunication. An empty tower explodes for about 600–760k and applies Damage Down and Paralysis to everyone.

mechanics.name: Heavenly Heel
mechanics.should_have_been: The off tank takes Heavenly Heel with personal mitigation. In this log that is the paladin, Absolute Gigachad. A lived heel is about 159–174k before mit. The main tank does not take the heel. Anyone else getting hit is their mistake. The off tank who dies to the real heel without personal mitigation owns that death.

mechanics.name: Holy Bladedance
mechanics.should_have_been: The cone after each tether. That tank takes several hits around 20–22k with personal mitigation. Anyone else in the cone owns that hit. A tank who dies on the real hits without personal mitigation owns that death.

mechanics.name: Lightning Storm
mechanics.should_have_been: Each safe triangle is healer in front, melee left, ranged right, tank in back. One hit each: tanks about 26–29k, everyone else about 38–45k. Two of the same non-tank role on one side, a player out of that spot, or two players clipping are mistakes. A clip is about 430–470k, and both players own it.

mechanics.name: Bright Flare
mechanics.should_have_been: The hourglass orbs are dodged. A hit is a mistake. One orb is about 61–67k on a tank and about 93–111k on a healer or DPS. Two players in the burst overlapped.

tank.lived: about 61k, and the hit is still a mistake

mechanics.name: Ascalon's Might
mechanics.should_have_been: One tank takes the three hits with personal mitigation. Anyone who is not a tank getting hit is their mistake. A tank who dies to the real hits without personal mitigation owns that death.

mechanics.name: Ascalon's Mercy Concealed
mechanics.should_have_been: Nobody is hit.

mechanics.name: Heavy Impact
mechanics.should_have_been: The knight's pulses, outward. A hit stuns and applies Damage Down. Clean pulls take 0. Both ability ids are this ring.

mechanics.name: Dragon's Glory
mechanics.should_have_been: A successful gaze is 0.

mechanics.name: Dragon's Gaze
mechanics.should_have_been: A successful gaze is 0.

mechanics.name: Holy Shield Bash
mechanics.should_have_been: Each tank takes one tether. The hit stuns. A non-tank who takes that stun dies. Stretch the tether and use personal mitigation. A short tether is the failed bash: hundreds of thousands to millions.

mechanics.name: Shining Blade
mechanics.should_have_been: The hourglass dash is dodged. A hit is a mistake.

mechanics.name: Heavens' Stake
mechanics.should_have_been: Four fire circles sit on the intercards, and Thordan is at the north edge. A hit is standing in the fire.

mechanics.name: Frostbite
mechanics.should_have_been: Run out of the ice before it ticks. Frostbite is standing in the puddle.

mechanics.name: Dimensional Collapse
mechanics.should_have_been: Puddles on the floor during the second wave. A hit applies Heavy and Damage Down. Any hit is a mistake. No lived band is stored.

mechanics.name: Conviction
mechanics.should_have_been: One player soaks each tower. Tanks take about 3k. Everyone else takes about 4.6–5.4k. An empty tower is Eternal Conviction.

mechanics.name: Holy Comet
mechanics.should_have_been: Each meteor drop is a light raidwide. Tanks take about 1.0–1.1k. Everyone else takes about 1.5–1.8k. Seven drops. Too close is Holy Impact.

mechanics.name: Faith Unmoving
mechanics.should_have_been: The knockback hits everyone. Tanks take about 2.7–3.1k. Everyone else takes about 4.5–5.2k. Players in the middle are knocked into a tower. Players on the outside immune the knockback. A wall is a mistake.

mechanics.name: Dark High Jump
mechanics.should_have_been: The circle dive. The marked player is alone on their Easthogg spot, and the tower drops where they stand. A landing people lived is about 9–23k. Anyone else in that landing is a mistake.

mechanics.name: Dark Elusive Jump
mechanics.should_have_been: The down arrow. East, facing east, so the tower drops behind them on the east side of the hitbox. Anyone else in that landing is a mistake. This log has no small hit stored.

mechanics.name: Eye of the Tyrant
mechanics.should_have_been: Five players who are not diving stack north, in front of Nidhogg. Tanks live about 37–48k. Everyone else lives about 50–70k. A hit over 100k is a short stack. Dying inside the lived band is the healers.

mechanics.name: Gnashing Wheel
mechanics.should_have_been: Inside the hitbox. Out is safe. Gnash and Lash means out, then in. The hit is about 12–23k and applies Damage Down. Any hit is a fail.

mechanics.name: Lashing Wheel
mechanics.should_have_been: Outside the hitbox. In is safe. Lash and Gnash means in, then out. The hit is about 12–23k and applies Damage Down. Any hit is a fail.

mechanics.name: Darkdragon Dive
mechanics.should_have_been: The player who soaks does not still have Fire Resistance Down II or Physical Vulnerability Up. A soak with those debuffs is about 445–570k. That player owns it.

mechanics.name: Darkdragon Dive
mechanics.should_have_been: One player soaks the tower. Tanks take about 32–54k. A non-tank soak that killed from a high bar was about 59–80k. A shield keeps them alive. Dying to that hit is the healers.

moments.should_have_been: One player soaks the tower. An empty tower explodes for about 1.4–3.0 million. On the first towers the 3s are the soakers. The log does not store who had the number, so the miss stays Missed soak.

healer.lived: about 59–80k killed; no survived non-tank soak is stored

dps.lived: about 59–80k killed; no survived non-tank soak is stored

mechanics.name: Geirskogul
mechanics.should_have_been: The soaker baits the clone's line out of the arena and steps through when the clone glows. Any hit is a fail. One player in the line owns it. Several players in one line means the baiter aimed it through them.

clusters.name: Ascalon's Mercy Concealed
clusters.summary: About 14 seconds. One tank stands in front of the boss. Everyone else stacks tight behind it, then dodges together. Nobody is hit.

parts.should_have_been: One tank stands in front of the boss. Everyone else stacks tight behind the boss, then dodges together. Nobody is hit. A cone baited from outside the stack is also the baiter's mistake.

clusters.name: Ascalon's Might
clusters.summary: The opener tankbuster, about 17 seconds in. Three hits on the main tank. When the warrior takes it, he invulns it or heavy-mits it.

parts.should_have_been: The main tank takes the three hits with personal mitigation, about 71–86k. Anyone who is not a tank getting hit is their mistake. A tank who dies to the real hits without personal mitigation owns that death.

clusters.name: Strength of the Ward
clusters.summary: About 43 to 65 seconds. Three knights dash and leave two safe triangles. Each triangle spreads Lightning Storm: healer in front, melee left, ranged right, tank in back. Heavy Impact then pulses outward. The party walks toward the middle, and Thordan's Ascalon's Mercy Concealed is a 4/4 split. On the second pulse the knights drop. Tanks take the two tethers. The tether stuns, and a non-tank who takes it dies. Three non-tanks take Skyward Leap: opposite Thordan as far as possible, east and west slightly toward the north. The other three stack under him. A leap death is a healer, a missing mitigation, or a clip. Floor puddles go out with that. Six towers follow. The three that are not on the Skyward Leap markers are not fixed, and two people in one of them is a miscommunication. A soaked tower deals little. An empty one explodes. Eternal Conviction still hits as this ends.

parts.should_have_been: The party is walking toward the middle while dodging the Heavy Impact pulses. Thordan is in the middle. This cast is a 4/4 split. Nobody is hit.

clusters.name: Heavenly Heel
clusters.summary: About 81 seconds. The off tank takes Heavenly Heel, then the main tank takes the three Ascalon's Might hits. Both are properly mitigated. In this log the paladin is the off tank and the warrior is the main tank. Anyone else getting hit owns that mistake. The off tank who dies on the real hit without personal mitigation owns that death. Sanctity of the Ward is next.

parts.should_have_been: The main tank takes the three hits with personal mitigation, about 59–86k. The off tank who took Heavenly Heel does not take these. Anyone who is not a tank getting hit is their mistake. A tank who dies to the real hits without personal mitigation owns that death.

clusters.name: Sanctity of the Ward
clusters.summary: About 112 seconds. The dark knight stands off center. Group 1 runs away from it and group 2 runs toward it. Those are the same two groups as the Lightning Storm triangles. The single sword always runs away. The double sword always runs toward it. A sword on the wrong group swaps with that role partner. Look away from both gazes. Two knights dash an hourglass and drop orbs. The dark knight jumps the single sword first, then the double sword, shared by 4, then repeats.

clusters.name: Meteors
clusters.summary: About 130 seconds. Fire circles on the intercards, Thordan at the north edge. Melee with healers east and west, tanks with ranged north and south. Prey belongs on north and south. Ice drops, then towers. Two outside towers and both players in that quarter go out. One outside tower and the prey role goes out. The other player takes the center tower clockwise from them, unless someone closer has that same tower. Comets follow. Eight towers then spawn outside: the prey role takes cardinals, the other group takes intercardinals. The knockback puts the middle into a tower. Players already outside immune it.

parts.should_have_been: Everyone is inside a tower. An empty tower explodes for the raid. Tanks take about 58–66k of that explosion. Everyone else takes about 90–105k. The players who missed the tower own it.

clusters.name: Dive from Grace
clusters.summary: About 17 seconds. Easthogg, true north, Nidhogg facing north. When the numbers appear, the 1s and 3s claim west, south, and east, and the 2s claim northwest and northeast. An up arrow takes west and faces east. A circle takes south. A down arrow takes east and faces east. A number with no arrows keeps the spots it claimed. The 3s soak the towers the 1s drop. The east and west 1s soak the towers the 2s drop. The 2s and the south 1 soak the towers the 3s drop. Five players who are not diving stack north for Eye of the Tyrant. Gnash and Lash is out, then in. Lash and Gnash is in, then out. After a soak, bait Geirskogul out and step through when the clone glows.
